verdict.line: You lose if Aatrox lands Infernal Chains and strings Q sweeps while you're tentacle-less; you win if your E lands while his E (Umbral Dash) is down.

brief.thesis: Both champions win trades through a single hard-engage tool on a long cooldown — his W (Infernal Chains) at 20/18/16/14/12s, your E (Test of Spirit) at 16/15/14/13/12s — so the lane is decided by who baits the other's cooldown first. Illaoi's trade math improves sharply near terrain where Tentacles can spawn, while Aatrox's improves in open lane where he can kite with E (Umbral Dash) and reset with Q resheathes. The 53.1% Illaoi win rate over 1083 games confirms this is winnable, but only if you fight on your terms.

theirWindow.when: your E (Test of Spirit) just went down
theirWindow.what: He will walk up and freely trade with Q (The Darkin Blade) swings and autos, since you have no spirit-rip threat to punish the engage. Hold position near minions and don't overextend until E is back.

yourWindow.when: his E (Umbral Dash) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Immediately throw E (Test of Spirit) — he cannot dash away to break the spirit link, so the echo damage and vessel threat land clean. Follow with W (Harsh Lesson) to leap in and trigger nearby Tentacles.

start.why: Picked in 59.6% of games at 51.6% win rate — the extra sustain and damage let you contest his Q pokes without falling behind on HP.

boots.why: 75.3% pick rate at 51% win — his autos and Q sweeps are physical, so the flat reduction blunts his all-in far better than Mercury's Treads here.

core.why: Armor shred directly counters his passive healing and lets your tentacles chew through his effective HP faster
The highest win-rate core path (68.2% over 88 games) pairs Cleaver's shred with slow to stop his E kiting
Tenacity and the shield spike counter his all-in burst once he's built Deathbringer Stance stacks

his healing from passive and E stacking is outpacing your damage
he rushes lifesteal or heavy auto-attack items early

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-winrate page (52.1% over the Conqueror alternative's 44.5%) — Grasp's proc rewards you for standing in extended trades near minions, which is exactly where Tentacles spawn

summoners.why: The Exhaust+Flash page holds the highest win rate (55.6% over Flash+Teleport's 49.3%) — Exhaust directly cuts his Deathbringer Stance burst and his R healing during the all-in window.

playing.title: Bait E before engaging
playing.detail: Walk into trade range only after you've seen his E (Umbral Dash) go on cooldown via a dash or escape attempt — without it he cannot break your E (Test of Spirit) link.

playing.title: Fight near terrain
playing.detail: Tentacles spawn on nearby impassible terrain, so pull trades toward walls or jungle edges rather than mid-lane open ground where he can freely kite with E.

playing.title: Punish his Q resheathe gap
playing.detail: His Q (The Darkin Blade) has three swings on a shared cooldown of 14/12/10/8/6s — after the third swing he has a brief window with no Q threat; use W (Harsh Lesson) here.

playing.title: Track Deathbringer Stance
playing.detail: His passive empowers a future auto with bonus magic damage and healing — watch for the stance glow and disengage or Exhaust before it procs on you.

playing.title: Use R to punish R
playing.detail: If he pops R (World Ender) to all-in, your R (Leap of Faith) hits him and spawns a Tentacle on him specifically, adding sustained damage he can't dash away from.

playing.title: Don't E into his E range
playing.detail: If he still has E (Umbral Dash) up, he can dash away mid-channel and avoid the spirit link entirely — wasting your 16-12s cooldown for nothing.

playing.title: Shred before committing late
playing.detail: Once Black Cleaver stacks are up, his passive and E healing fall off hard — hold all-ins until you've landed a few stacks rather than opening with E.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG match data on the current patch; the trade timing and cooldown-bait reasoning is my own tactical read, not sourced from OP.GG.

stats.opponentTip: Aatrox is a difficult matchup as he can easily dodge [E] through (E) while dealing damage with (Q), not to mention his health regeneration or abilities that do not consume mana. However, Illaoi can gain the upper hand if [E] lands while (E) is on cooldown.
